title: Initiative and Turn-Length Bottlenecks
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session combat_started=yes
| stats avg(initiative_setup_min) as avg_initiative_min, avg(avg_turn_seconds) as avg_turn_seconds, count as combats by campaign
| sort - avg_turn_seconds
description: Measures where combat starts or player turns are taking too long, slowing a session's momentum.
value: Pacing problems are easier to fix when you can see whether the delay is in setup, rules lookup, or turns themselves.
implementation: Capture initiative and turn timing in session logs and trend average setup minutes and turn seconds by campaign.
visualization: Bar chart of initiative setup time and turn length by campaign.
grandmaExplanation: It counts where battles get bogged down so you can speed up the slow parts of game night.
